title.narrative: Forest Governance, Markets and Climate (FGMC) Programme II

description.narrative: Driving Transformational Change to Mitigate Direct and Indirect Mining Impacts on High-Integrity Forests: Transforming mining governance to safeguard high-integrity tropical forests, advance Nature Positive practices, and ensure equitable benefits for Indigenous Peoples, local communities, women, and biodiversity from producer to consumer countries

The Forest Governance, Markets and Climate (“FGMC”) Programme is a global programme of the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (“FCDO”) with the broad aim of strengthening forest stewardship in developing countries by supporting inclusive multistakeholder deliberations on national and international rules, incentivised by market mechanisms and trade regulations. The second phase of the programme (FGMC2) started in 2024.
